name: wardenx
description: WardenX - multi-tenant hospice EHR SaaS. Architecture-fitness kit, spec corpus, and staged implementation monorepo.

scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio
scripts.db:down: docker compose stop postgres redis minio
scripts.db:seed:all: bun run db:seed && bun run db:seed:org-admin && bun run db:seed:patients && bun run db:seed:staff && bun run db:seed:clinical && bun run db:seed:mdm && bun run db:seed:terminology && bun run db:import:hope-spec && bun run db:seed:consent-types && bun run db:seed:portal && bun run db:seed:org-structure && bun run db:seed:scenario-admissions && bun run db:seed:scenario-delgado-active && bun run db:seed:scenario-clinical && bun run db:seed:scenario-orders-idg && bun run db:seed:scenario-field-ops && bun run db:seed:scenario-billing && bun run db:seed:scenario-remaining && bun run db:seed:scenario-reporting && bun run db:seed:scenario-cop27-api -- --apply --local-credentials --strict
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && bun run db:up && bun run db:wait -- --expect-empty && bun run db:migrate && bun run db:seed:all
scripts.dev: bun run dev:backend & bun run dev:web
scripts.arch:graph: depcruise apps packages --config architecture/.dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type dot | dot -T svg > docs/architecture-graph.svg
scripts.client:check: openapi-typescript docs/api/openapi.json -o /tmp/wardenx-client-schema.ts && diff -q packages/ui/src/core/api/schema.ts /tmp/wardenx-client-schema.ts || (echo 'FAIL packages/ui/src/core/api/schema.ts is out of date. Run: bun run client:gen' && exit 1)
